module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input enable,
  input S,
  input A,
  input B,
  input C,
  output reg Z
);

  reg [6:0] stack;

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (enable) begin
      stack <= {S, stack[6:1]}; // Shift right, new bit in MSB
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    if (enable) begin
      Z = stack[6]; // Output the new bit when enabled
    end else begin
      // Normal operation: output based on control signals
      Z = A ? B : (B ? C : stack[0]); // Prioritize A, then B, then stack
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [7:0] a,
  input [7:0] b,
  output [7:0] s,
  output overflow
);

  wire [8:0] c;  // Carry for each stage (c[0] is carry-in for bit 0)
  wire [7:0] p, g;  // Propagate and Generate signals

  assign c[0] = 1'b0;  // Initial carry-in is 0

  genvar i;
  generate
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin: adder_stage
      assign p[i] = a[i] ^ b[i];           // Propagate signal
      assign g[i] = a[i] & b[i];           // Generate signal
      assign c[i+1] = g[i] | (p[i] & c[i]); // Carry equation
      assign s[i] = p[i] ^ c[i];           // Sum bit
    end
  endgenerate

  assign overflow = c[8] ^ c[7];  // Overflow based on MSB carry-in and carry-out

endmodule

  output logic out

module TopModule (
  input d,
  input done_counting,
  input ack,
  input [9:0] state, // 10-bit one-hot current state
  output B3_next,
  output S_next,
  output S1_next,
  output Count_next,
  output Wait_next,
  output done,
  output counting,
  output shift_ena
);

  // One-hot state decoding
  wire current_state = (state[0] == 1'b1) ? 10'd0 :
                       (state[1] == 1'b1) ? 10'd1 :
                       (state[2] == 1'b1) ? 10'd2 :
                       (state[3] == 1'b1) ? 10'd3 :
                       (state[4] == 1'b1) ? 10'd4 :
                       (state[5] == 1'b1) ? 10'd5 :
                       (state[6] == 1'b1) ? 10'd6 :
                       (state[7] == 1'b1) ? 10'd7 :
                       (state[8] == 1'b1) ? 10'd8 :
                       (state[9] == 1'b1) ? 10'd9 :
                       10'd0;

  // Output assignments based on current state and inputs
  assign B3_next = (current_state == 10'd0); // BS
  assign S_next  = (current_state == 10'd1) ? ack :
                   (current_state == 10'd2) ? 1'b1 :
                   1'b0;
  assign S1_next = (current_state == 10'd3) ? d : 1'b0;
  assign Count_next = (current_state == 10'd4) ? done_counting :
                      (current_state == 10'd5) ? 1'b1 :
                      1'b0;
  assign Wait_next = (current_state == 10'd6) ? done_counting :
                     (current_state == 10'd7) ? 1'b1 :
                     1'b0;
  assign done = (current_state == 10'd8); // IE
  assign counting = (current_state == 10'd7); // DC
  assign shift_ena = (current_state == 10'd5) ? ack :
                     (current_state == 10'd6) ? 1'b1 :
                     1'b0;

endmodule

module instr_reg (
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input [1:0] fetch,
    input [7:0] data,
    output [2:0] ins,
    output [4:0] ad1,
    output [7:0] ad2
);

reg [7:0] instruction;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst) begin
        instruction <= 8'b0;
    end else begin
        case (fetch)
            2'b01: instruction[7:3] <= data; // Update upper bits
            2'b10: instruction[2:0] <= data; // Update lower bits
            default: ; // No change for other values
        endcase
    end
end

assign ins = instruction[7:5];
assign ad1 = instruction[4:0];
assign ad2 = instruction[7:0];

endmodule

module ROM (
    input wire [7:0] addr,        // 8-bit Address input
    output reg [15:0] dout        // 16-bit Data output
);

// ROM content definition using case statement
always @* begin
    case (addr[1:0])  // Using lower 2 bits of address for case grouping
        2'b00: dout = 16'hF000;   // Address 0-3: Output 0xF000
        2'b01: dout = 16'h049E;   // Address 4-7: Output 0x049E
        2'b10: dout = 16'h03B2;   // Address 8-15: Output 0x03B2
        default: dout = 16'h0000; // Default case (unreachable with 8-bit addr)
    endcase
end

endmodule
